Name: Inflatable Kayak
Author: tangsuanz
Description:
```
[center][size=5][b]充气皮划艇 Inflatable Kayak[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=3]在威利商店购买充气皮划艇,放到水面上,划着去钓鱼 | Buy it at Willy's shop, place it on the water, and row out to fish[/size][/center]
[line]
[b][size=4][color=#00b0f0]简介 Introduction[/color][/size][/b]

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]

受够了码头边那几个可怜的钓点?现在你可以在威利商店买到一艘充气皮划艇——
把它放到任何水域,坐着它划到海中央,享受专属于你的深水钓位。

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53273/53273-1790935046-2123114134.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53273/53273-1790935065-637031423.png[/img]

[size=4][b]English[/b][/size]

Tired of the same old fishing spots by the docks? Now you can buy an inflatable
kayak from Willy's shop — place it on any body of water, hop in, and row to the
middle of the ocean for your own private deep-water fishing spot.

[line]
[b][size=4][color=#00b0f0]功能 Features[/color][/size][/b]

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]威利商店有售[/b] —— 前往威利的鱼店购买,仅需 2500g[/*]
[*][b]一键放船[/b] —— 手持皮划艇按右键,船会自动放到你身边最近的水面[/*]
[*][b]一键上船[/b] —— 走近船,右键即可上船[/*]
[*][b]水上航行[/b] —— 划行速度比马快一点,可到达任何开阔水域[/*]
[*][b]船上钓鱼[/b] —— 在船上右键照常抛竿,深水鱼随便钓[/*]
[*][b]贴岸下船[/b] —— 划到岸边,右键即可上岸[/*]
[*][b]左键收船[/b] —— 鼠标指着船按左键,皮划艇折叠收回背包,随带随走[/*]
[*][b]水花特效[/b] —— 船尾尾流、船头浪花、船底泡沫,静止时也有轻轻的浮动感[/*]
[*][b]手柄支持[/b] —— 完整支持手柄操作(A 键 = 放船/上下船,X 键 = 收船)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]English[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Sold at Willy's shop[/b] — head over to the fish shop and grab one for just 2,500g[/*]
[*][b]One-click placing[/b] — hold the kayak and right-click; it's placed on the nearest water tile[/*]
[*][b]One-click boarding[/b] — walk up to the kayak and right-click to hop in[/*]
[*][b]Sailing[/b] — a bit faster than a horse, and you can reach any open water[/*]
[*][b]Fish from the boat[/b] — right-click to cast as usual, deep-water fish included[/*]
[*][b]Shore disembark[/b] — row to the shore and right-click to step ashore[/*]
[*][b]Pick it up[/b] — aim at the kayak and left-click to fold it back into your backpack[/*]
[*][b]Splash effects[/b] — stern wake, bow waves and hull foam; even idle, the boat gently bobs[/*]
[*][b]Controller support[/b] — fully playable on gamepad (A = place/board/disembark, X = pick up)[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=4][color=#00b0f0]操作 How to Use[/color][/size][/b]

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]

[b]鼠标:[/b]
[list]
[*]右键点击水面 → 放下皮划艇[/*]
[*]右键点击船 → 上船 / 贴岸时下船[/*]
[*]左键点击船(指向船时) → 收回背包[/*]
[/list]
[b]手柄:[/b]
[list]
[*]A 键 → 放船 / 上船 / 贴岸下船[/*]
[*]X 键 → 收船回背包(面朝船时)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]English[/b][/size]

[b]Mouse:[/b]
[list]
[*]Right-click water → place the kayak[/*]
[*]Right-click the kayak → board / disembark when near the shore[/*]
[*]Left-click the kayak (aiming at it) → pack into backpack[/*]
[/list]
[b]Controller:[/b]
[list]
[*]A → place / board / disembark near the shore[/*]
[*]X → pack the kayak away (while facing it)[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[b][size=4][color=#00b0f0]安装 Installation[/color][/size][/b]

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]安装最新版 [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url](4.0 以上)[/*]
[*]解压后将 [b]Kayak[/b] 文件夹放入游戏的 [b]Mods[/b] 目录[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏即可[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]English[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] (4.0+)[/*]
[*]Unzip and drop the [b]Kayak[/b] folder into your game's [b]Mods[/b] directory[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b][size=4][color=#00b0f0]技术说明 Technical Notes[/color][/size][/b]


[spoiler]
[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]皮划艇为自定义物品(Data/Objects)+ 自定义商店条目(Data/Shops),不依赖 JsonAssets[/*]
[*]水面航行通过 Harmony 补丁实现,仅在你"处于船上"时介入碰撞判定[/*]
[*]船的停泊位置保存在玩家 modData 中,随存档保存[/*]
[*]水花为程序生成的粒子效果,不使用额外贴图资源[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]English[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The kayak is a custom item (Data/Objects) plus a custom shop entry (Data/Shops); no JsonAssets dependency[/*]
[*]Water sailing is implemented with a Harmony patch that only touches collision checks while you're aboard[/*]
[*]The kayak's parked position is stored in the player's modData and saved with your save file[/*]
[*]Splash effects are procedurally generated particles — no extra texture assets needed[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[line]
[center]
喜欢这个 Mod 的话,点个 [b]Endorse[/b] 就是最大的支持! / If you like this mod, an [b]endorsement[/b] is much appreciated![/center]
